title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on energy-intensive industries
part_text: 14.Highlights the importance of a just transition to assist areas heavily reliant on EIIs, by keeping and creating quality jobs through upskilling and reskilling programmes for workers and through the effective use of regional support mechanisms, such as the Just Transition Fund and the Cohesion Fund; stresses that public support will be pivotal for the transition of EIIs and that this support must be made conditional on respect for strict social conditionality, including respect for collective agreements, good working conditions and decent wages; stresses that companies that receive public funding must not be allowed to distribute excessive dividends, resort to tax havens or proceed with collective layoffs and that they must reimburse public funding received in the event of non-compliance with their obligations; recalls that companies that do not comply with labour law and health and safety regulations should not be able to benefit from direct public subsidies and should be excluded from public procurement tendering procedures; welcomes the Union of Skills initiative to ensure a good match between skills and labour market demands;
